name: search

code.description: Read-only JS over `catalog` (see description). Returns its JSON result.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'pad sketch rectangle', 'through hole pocket', 'fillet edges'.

id.description: Catalog entry id for full details + example source.

name: execute
job_status
description: Returns the job state (queued|running|completed|failed|cancelled), geometry, validation checks (expected vs actual), artifact list and a structured error with hint. Optionally waits up to `waitMs` for completion, includes the status-transition log, or a bounded tail of worker logs. Set `cancel: true` to cancel a queued/running job.

waitMs.description: Long-poll up to this many ms for a terminal state.

includeLogs.description: Append the stderr tail (<=4 KB) of this worker phase.

name: artifacts
description: Lists a completed job's validated artifacts (FCStd/STEP/STL) with size and sha256. With `artifactId`, returns a download reference: an MCP resource URI (freecad-artifact://<job>/<artifact>, readable via resources/read) and, for local stdio deployments, a file:// URI. Set `includeContent` to embed the file (base64, size-capped). Artifacts are addressed only by server-issued ids, never by paths.
